name: auth-verify-cronjob-failures
description: Count failures from the in-cluster auth verification CronJob (auth-verify-prod).
filter: resource.type="k8s_container" AND resource.labels.namespace_name="mereka-lms" AND resource.labels.container_name="auth-verify" AND resource.labels.pod_name=~"^auth-verify-prod-" AND (textPayload=~"FAILED \\(" OR textPayload=~"^BAD " OR jsonPayload.message=~"FAILED \\(")
